notes.title: Update 0.65 New Monster, story beats and more!
notes.content:
Patch 0.65 Notes — Highlights
New Content

New Monster: A fresh bedside stalker with its own audio tells. Watch, hide, or die.

Environmental Story Beats: Rooms now sprout unsettling objects and drawings at unpredictable times, revealing fragments of the crash and its aftermath.

Escalating Difficulty: Every dawn shortens reaction windows and speeds up attack cycles. Surviving gets harder night-by-night.

Experience Tweaks

Night-End Overhaul: No more black-screen . Blink once and you'll be awake.

Balance / Fixes

Spawn timings tightened to keep pressure consistent.

Minor audio stingers re-EQ’d for clearer directional cues.
